Good, make a new documentation PR:

- pull the latest version of the overleaf (has been edited online)
I’ll inspect the TDR submodule and local edits, pull the latest Overleaf changes, and prepare a documentation PR recording the update.

Then learn from the changes for future writing:

- do not write down what did not work
- focus on describing what is the current baseline (not what were intermediate steps)
- Propose (don't push to overleaf yet) how to shorten the pixel section, particularly given that the target is an accurate full simulation description, i.e. the mounting and cooling sections could be shortened

I found new online edits and will include them in the documentation PR. I’ll use them to guide future writing toward the current baseline, and prepare a concrete proposal for shortening the pixel section. The proposal will stay in nODD for review.

The online edit removes substantial text from all three tracker subsystem sections. I’ll follow the same approach for pixels: keep the dimensions, material inventory and service paths needed for simulation, and condense the mounting and cooling explanations. I’ll make the proposed cuts explicit so you can review them before any Overleaf update.

The synchronized report compiles on Overleaf as 36 pages, with zero reported errors or warnings. The proposal is ready for review: five pixel subsections, eight main figure groups, and compact support, cooling and routing tables. It preserves the sensitive geometry and passive-material inventory.

The latest Overleaf revision is now pulled into your local TDR submodule. I also added the writing guidance and shortening proposal to the new documentation branch. I’m publishing the PR with the proposal kept separate from the authored TDR source.

Created [PR #59](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/59), pulling the latest Overleaf edits and saving your writing guidance for future TDR work.

The [pixel shortening proposal]([redacted] recommends:

- Five subsections focused on the current baseline.
- Shorter mounting/cooling prose with compact parameter tables.
- Eight main figure groups instead of thirteen.

It targets roughly one-third less text while preserving simulation-relevant detail. **The proposal has not been pushed to Overleaf.**

The synchronized report compiles: 36 pages, zero errors or warnings. Local validation passed; GitHub CI is pending.
